description: Actual built-in ImageGen prompts. Tool did not expose model version, seed or quality; those values are unknown.
tree22: Use case: style-transfer. Create one faithful high-definition 3D modeling reference of Red Alert 2 temperate TREE22, using the attached original sprite as the identity evidence. Preserve its slender slightly curved single brown trunk, open crown of long arching green palm-like fronds, narrow leaflets, asymmetric silhouette, proportions, original elevated viewing angle and olive green palette. Render a complete isolated realistic tree including trunk down to root contact point, modest margins, on plain neutral charcoal background. No ground plane, base, cast shadow, scenery, text or decorations. Natural detailed leaf and bark materials, no plastic. Keep negative spaces between fronds. Conservatively infer hidden leaves only to complete a volumetric tree; do not add a second trunk or enlarge crown. Output a clear full-object reference for textured PBR image-to-3D generation.
tree10: Use case: style-transfer. Create one faithful high-definition 3D modeling reference of Red Alert 2 temperate TREE10, using the attached original sprite as identity evidence. Preserve its slender brown branching trunk with visible fork, irregular open broadleaf crown composed of distinct uneven green foliage clumps, gaps between branches, proportions, original elevated view and yellow-olive green palette. Render complete isolated realistic tree including trunk down to root contact point, modest margins, on plain neutral charcoal background. No ground plane, display base, cast shadow, scenery, text or ornaments. Natural detailed small leaves and bark; avoid toy plastic, spherical uniform crown or extra trunks. Conservatively infer hidden branches only to complete real volume. Full tree reference for textured PBR image-to-3D generation, silhouette fidelity over extra detail.
grass: Use case: style-transfer. Produce a seamless tileable PBR base-color texture for Red Alert 2 temperate grass ground, taking the attached original diamond tile as palette and material evidence only. Output a full square top-down orthographic grass texture, edge-to-edge with NO diamond shape and NO transparency. Short natural yellow-olive grass with irregular small green clumps and restrained dry straw/tan soil details, matching the original olive-yellow palette, realistic fine grass blade texture. This is a diffuse albedo map: even flat illumination, no directional shadows, ambient occlusion, highlights, objects, rocks, flowers, horizon, text or border. Opposite edges must connect seamlessly when repeated. Avoid regular waves, stripes, grid, fabric texture or large distinctive repeating patches. Square texture 1024 by 1024 if available.
rock: Use case: style-transfer. Create a square seamless tileable diffuse albedo texture of a natural weathered rock cliff face, based on the warm ochre brown rock material visible in the supplied original Red Alert 2 temperate cliff tile. The image is material evidence only: do not reproduce the diamond tile, grass patches, viewpoint, cliff silhouette or baked shadows. Fill entire square edge-to-edge with realistic irregular sandstone-like rock, fine cracks and subtle uneven strata. Muted warm brown/ochre palette, physically plausible stone detail, no wood grain, no regular stripes, no grid, no grass, no objects, no text. Uniform flat illumination and no directional lighting, cast shadow or specular highlights. Opposite edges should tile without visible seams. This will texture real 3D cliff geometry.
